nodes.label: Agara Coffee
nodes.rationale: Combines premium coffee with functional ingredients (Lion's Mane, Chromemate Chromium, Green Coffee Bean, Berberine HCL, Saffron, Lotus Leaf, Citrus Aurantium, L-Theanine) for clean sustained energy, focus, and wellness support without unverified medical claims.

nodes.label: MATCHAGARA
nodes.rationale: Ceremonial-grade organic matcha combined with Lion's Mane mushroom, L-Theanine, Berberine HCL, Chromemate Chromium, Saffron, Lotus Leaf, and Citrus Aurantium for sustained energy, sharper focus, and mood balance.

nodes.label: Agara Research & Claim Guardrails
nodes.rationale: Treat brand ingredient lists as reported claims rather than verified dosages, distinguish general ingredient science from finished product claims, and avoid disease-treatment, weight-loss, detox, and blood-sugar claims on public pages.
